verdict.rationale: SumUp runs an officially managed MCP server (mcp.sumup.com/mcp) allowing MCP clients to interact with SumUp APIs for account management, checkouts, and payments, plus an Agent Toolkit that adds these tools to LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or MCP-based agentic apps. This is directly documented vendor capability, though independent hands-on validation is limited to docs/probes rather than community usage reports.
